title: R2-W3's silent telemetry-off guard is bypassed in the app by the `--stats-out=<path>` equals form — argv silently ignored, stream off, exit 0
detail: `app --stats-out=/tmp/x.csv` runs with stats_live=false: no stream file, no diagnostic, exit 0 — exactly the silent telemetry-off class R2-W3 was fixed to eliminate, reachable via the common `=` token shape.
recommended_fix: In the app loop, reject any unrecognized `-`/`--`-prefixed token (usage + exit 2), mirroring the harness's loud failure instead of silently ignoring non-matching argv.

title: Harness stats-stream write failure is logged but never affects the exit code — 'green' exit 0 with no stream file
detail: Scripted/CI consumers of `harness run <demo> --stats-out <path>` that check the exit code see green despite no stream being written; only stderr carries the failure. App-side is exit 1.
recommended_fix: Thread the write result out of write_file (return bool or Error) and count a stats-write failure into run_demo's failure set / a non-zero exit in main.

title: R2-N8 persists (carry-forward): no automated coverage of the new --stats-out CLI error paths in either parser
detail: The exit-2 guards for dangling/duplicate/empty/flag-shaped tokens exist (R2-W3 fix verified in code) but have no pinned regression test; r3 claimed live manual checks only. Matches r2's R2-N8, unclaimed in the rework.
recommended_fix: Extract the argv validation into a testable proc (e.g. parse_stats_out(rest) -> (path, Error)) and pin the four rejection shapes plus the one-demo guard with @(test) cases.
